scientific_stage: Blind M3 dominant-mass weighted graph prediction on the frozen 15-query sigma-regime battery

dominant_mass.selection: minimal descending joint-weight prefix whose cumulative mass is >= target_retained_mass
dominant_mass.maximum_truncation_error: 1-retained_mass, pointwise for every sigma query after renormalization

simulation_budget.allocation: integer minimax allocation for the renormalized retained weights
simulation_budget.allocation_objective_upper_bound: minimize (1/4) * sum_j alpha_j^2 / N_j subject to sum_j N_j=B and N_j>=1
simulation_budget.allocation_algorithm: start N_j=1; allocate each additional trajectory to the member maximizing alpha_j^2/(N_j*(N_j+1)); ties by lower joint rank
simulation_budget.seed_rule: rank r in 1..K uses seeds seed_base + (r-1)*stride + k for k=0..N_r(max)-1

theory.conditional_mc_variance: Var[sum_j alpha_j p_hat_j] = sum_j alpha_j^2 p_j(1-p_j)/N_j under independent member seed streams
theory.integer_budget_rule: greedy marginal allocation above is the discrete separable-convex minimizer

queries.battery: same frozen 15-query G0/G1/G2 battery as final M2 experiment
queries.same_provider_process_family: latent hypotheses only; no hidden WB parameters read

budget_interpretation: B=1400 is a 48% reduction from M2 graph cost 2700; B=2000 is the original planned M3 budget and a 26% reduction from M2.
next_gate: After all B=700/1400/2000 M3 predictions are materialized and hash-frozen, define a separate fresh matched-D300 white-box evaluation contract. No graph-WB result may alter the retained set, weights, allocation, or budgets.
